description:
This is a fully remote role in the United States.

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, Contracts, you will play a pivotal role as a domain expert in how we continue to build out our contract modeling products. Turquoise is looking for a talented, product-minded, analytical individual with a deep fluency in the mechanics and implications of managed care contracts, payer policies, claims, and remits data, who can translate that background into clear, impactful outcomes in close partnership with our product team.

In this role, you will work alongside our product team to support and inform key product decisions through your domain experience. This requires a thorough understanding of contract mechanisms, including provision hierarchy, bundling, qualifier logic, and government fee schedules, to support our ability to accurately model a wide range of contract structures. In addition, you will be able to apply your SQL skills to investigate and explore claims and remits data to inform product decisions through clear and easy to understand documented findings. Your expertise will also be leveraged through supporting claims validation variance exercises, assessing the impact of payer policies, tracing denials back to contract terms or policies, and improving our claims mapping process.

We encourage you to bring your innovative, analytical, and resourceful mindset to this role. You'll have the chance to solve unique product-oriented problems, expand on your subject matter expertise, and build strong relationships at Turquoise. We measure success by your thoughtful and efficient collaboration with product and engineering to ensure sustainable, long-term solutions for our customers.

What You’ll Do

  • Investigate and analyze managed care contracts, claims and remit data, and payer policies to answer key product questions

  • Provide high-quality written documentation that highlights product needs, feasibility, and customer impact

  • Inventory contract calculation methodologies to define an accurate and scalable modeling approach

  • Use SQL to investigate claims and remit data and translate findings into clear next steps

  • Support claims validation variance exercises by classifying pricing variances across 835s by root cause to enable a clear target for AI-assisted validation

  • Assess the impact of payer policies, including which policy attributes recur and which can be computed against claims versus which require human judgment

  • Trace denials back to contract terms and policies to be able to classify Claim Adjustment Reason Codes (CARCs) as attributable to the contract, to policy, or to neither

  • Improve our claims mapping process by identifying gaps in automated mapping, finding patterns, and determining the best path forward: better rules, better reference data, or human review by design

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in managed care contracting, revenue cycle, or reimbursement / claims analytics

  • Hands-on experience with institutional and professional claims and remits

  • A deep understanding of contract modeling, provisions, and methodologies

  • Working knowledge of payer policies and their financial impact, including how they interact with contract terms

  • Strong SQL skills and technical experience to independently explore and analyze complex claims and remit datasets

  • Product intuition and the ability to turn ambiguous questions into clear answers and recommendations

  • Excellent written communication, with the ability to produce findings that give others clear next steps

 
 

About Turquoise Health

Turquoise Health is a Series C price transparency platform for finance leaders across healthcare. Backed by a16z, Oak HC/FT, Adams Street, Yosemite, Bessemer Venture Partners, and others, we power price transparency for 300+ enterprise organizations and are building the infrastructure for a more open, efficient healthcare marketplace. We're a remote-first, US-based team that values transparency, empathy, inclusivity, creativity, and ownership.

We operate on US business hours and work with clients entirely based in the US. For this role, we are seeking US-based candidates.

We strongly encourage BIPOC, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ folks to apply for any open roles of interest. Healthcare affects all people differently, but it significantly affects those in underserved communities. With a robust, diverse team, we are stronger and better equipped to change the future of healthcare for all.

Work Authorization

This role requires current authorization to work in the United States. Turquoise does not sponsor employment visas (H-1B, PERM, etc.) or assume sponsorship of existing visas for this position.

Disability Accommodation Email

Turquoise is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require assistance or an accommodation with the hiring process, please contact recruiting@turquoise.health

Note: All official communication from Turquoise will come from a @turquoise.health email address and all open roles are listed at turquoise.health/careers. We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.
